title: Raibach Prompt Composer Catalog
whatThisFileIs: THE SCHEMA. What the server validates an A2UI payload against — an unknown component fails loud with HTTP 503. Three files in this repository are called some version of 'registry' — this is the validation schema, NOT the allowlist the AI reads and NOT the Figma map. The allowlist is frontend/src/shared/tag-registry.ts; the design relationship is frontend/src/components/registry.json.
description: Custom A2UI v0.9.1 catalog for the Raibach Design System Lifecycle Management platform. Agent can only render components from this allowlist.

allOf.description: Live telemetry feed for the rail's Trace view. Implemented by <trace-feed> in src/components/lit/trace-feed.ts. It is a VIEW and fetches nothing: the app logger and Sentry's global-scope breadcrumbs are read by lib/trace-source.ts, and the shell writes them into the data model. Every value it draws arrives through the two bindings below.

entries.description: Data-bound list of trace entries, newest first. Object form: {"path": "/trace/entries"}. Unset is NOT empty: the feed draws its waiting state until the path has been written, because an empty list is a claim that the app has logged nothing.

breadcrumbCount.description: How many breadcrumbs Sentry's global scope is holding, bound as {"path": "/trace/breadcrumbCount"}. Written on the same channel as entries. Both forms are spelled out here because common_types.json has no DynamicNumber and the bound form is an object, not a number — a bare "type": "number" would describe a payload this catalog refuses.

user-response-bubble.description: The response row inside the chat output card — the design's "user-response-bubble", Figma node 40001119:6352 (file 20UPR2KQMsbAxlo5NJb1se), implemented by <user-response-bubble> in src/components/lit/user-response-bubble.ts. A 6px-radius #CBE6E3 row — or the seat's own --chat-user-bg when it sets one — holding a 19×19 mark and one line of Inter 500 13/20 in #171717. It is a DRAWING: the Figma node carries no annotation, so the element declares no events and nothing about it is invented; the host supplies the line.

text.description: The line to draw, e.g. {"path": "/session/right_column/last_response"}. Optional — the wireframe's own copy is sample text, not a default.

trace-feed.description: The same component as TraceFeed, under its element tag. Both names are listed on purpose: the renderer resolves them to one element (COMPOSITE_MAP in a2ui-renderer.ts maps TraceFeed to <trace-feed>), while the allowlist and the catalog audit name the TAG — so a payload or a client validating by tag has to find it here as well. The two bindings are described on the TraceFeed entry.

allOf.description: The flow, drawn — the output column's canvas, implemented by <agent-flow> in src/components/lit/agent-flow.ts. It is a VIEW and fetches nothing: shared/agentFlow.ts builds the graph from facts the app already holds (the prompt's own seats, the finding, and the run's own responses) and the shell writes it into the data model. One binding carries the whole graph, so there is exactly one path to keep true.

flow.description: The graph, bound as {"path": "/session/middle_column/flow"}: {label, nodes[], edges[], unresolved[], absent[]}. A node carries its SHAPE in `kind` — the canonical section id (system-role, user-role, agent-role, tool-call, custom-data), a step name, or the check that made the note — never a label, because a label is presentation a person may rename. Unset is NOT empty: with no path written the canvas waits, while an empty node list claims there is nothing to draw.

agent-flow.description: The same component as AgentFlow, under its element tag. Both names are listed on purpose: the renderer resolves them to one element (COMPOSITE_MAP in a2ui-renderer.ts maps AgentFlow to <agent-flow>), while the allowlist and the catalog audit name the TAG — so a payload or a client validating by tag has to find it here as well. The binding is described on the AgentFlow entry.

allOf.description: THE PLUG-IN — the drawing and Grace's seat as one place, implemented as a CONTAINER by <agent-canvas> in src/components/lit/agent-canvas.ts. It declares two slots and the ENVELOPE fills them: the drawing in "flow", her seat in "seat" — the same model workspace-layout uses for its columns, and the only one this protocol allows, because children come from the adjacency list and never from a component's own template (surfaces cannot nest). It owns behaviour around its slots: the seat's column (width, motion, the gripper and its release) and the link between the halves. It does NOT own her bindings — those are the envelope's bindings on her seat, which is what makes her a surface seat. Sheet: AGENTIC_EDITOR/11-THE-PLUGIN.md.

theme.description: The drawing's tone. Empty is the mid-tone this design is drawn in; "dark" is the reference's near-black surface. It reaches the ground her column stands on.

collapsed.description: True when she is away and only her rail shows. The container owns the width, so the flag lives here; her rail and the gripper write it too, because it is one fact.

children.description: The two slots, filled BY NAME from the envelope: {"flow": <id of the drawing>, "seat": <id of her chat panel>}. Each child carries its own bindings — the drawing its graph, her seat its conversation, session and readouts — so nothing is forwarded through this element.

agent-canvas.description: The same component as AgentCanvas, under its element tag. Both names are listed on purpose: the renderer resolves them to one element (COMPOSITE_MAP in a2ui-renderer.ts maps AgentCanvas to <agent-canvas>), while the allowlist and the catalog audit name the TAG. The slots are described on the AgentCanvas entry.

allOf.description: The catalog checker's open findings, drawn in the chat panel's "view" slot. Implemented by <chat-repair-actions> in src/components/lit/chat-repair-actions.ts. A VIEW: it fetches nothing and composes no sentence about a finding — the writer maps the report the checker already wrote (frontend/catalog-audit/<pipeline>.json) into rows of {id, text, level} and binds them here, so the list cannot disagree with the check that produced it.

findings.description: Data-bound rows, blocking first: {"path": "/findings"}. Each row is {id, text, level}, with text and level composed by the writer. Unset is NOT empty: the element draws its waiting state until the path has been written, because an empty list is the claim that the checker found nothing open.

allOf.description: The bounded surface Grace assembles A2UI content into. <ai-surface-sandbox> is defined (components/lit/ai-surface-sandbox.ts) and named by the allowlist, but this schema did not list it - so any payload naming it was rejected with a 503.

isAIAssembling.description: True while an assembly is in flight; the sandbox shows its spinner slot.

text.description: The text content to display. Simple Markdown supported (no HTML, images, or links).

variant.description: A hint for the base text style. 'greeting' is the Grace welcome-message style used at the top of assembled surfaces.

url.description: The URL of the image. Must be a registered catalog ID from the A2UI Image Catalog (raibach-logo, card-bg-design-system, card-img-default, molecule-logo).

description.description: Accessibility text for the image (WCAG 2.1 AA required).

allOf.description: A layout component that arranges its children horizontally.

children.description: Defines the children by ID reference. Use explicitList for fixed children or template for data-driven lists.

allOf.description: A layout component that arranges its children vertically.

children.description: Defines the children by ID reference.

child.description: The ID of the single child component to be rendered inside the card.
The ID of the child component (typically a Text for the label).

agent-card.x-deprecated-reason: No element defines this tag. The card is drawn INSIDE ConsoleCardGrid by <agent-card-element>, which that grid's own template instantiates (an internal sub-piece, like chat-messages inside chat-panel). Emitting this name draws an empty box. Use ConsoleCardGrid with items bound to /cards.

x-figma-source.description: Design source of truth. The extracted style spec (every fill, stroke, effect, font, weight, size, line height, bounding box) is cached in PostgreSQL figma_specs and served by the spec endpoint.

allOf.description: Lit web component <agent-card-element>. Console prompt card (262x251px) per Figma node 40001114:5813 "console-card-design-system". Renders header (molecule logo, function line, category line), title + description body (with the ##PROMPT## lead), and footer (version pill with status, like count with heart). Card background is tinted per category via category_color. All field values are sourced from PostgreSQL (prompt_sessions + categories tables) and must be carried through VERBATIM — never invented or renamed. Registered as custom element: agent-card-element.

id.description: Unique identifier for the card (maps to prompt session ID).

title.description: Card title displayed in the card-title row (16px bold, 2-line clamp).

function.description: The function level — the line ABOVE the category in the card header (14px bold #F6C031). Falls back to the design's own sample line 'Function like Repair' until the data supplies it.

category.description: Content category label shown under the function line (12px bold, categories table title_color).

category_color.description: Hex color tinting the card background, from the categories table (name → color). Fallback '#1C2F4E' (the design's own fill) when the category is unregistered.

category_title_color.description: Color of the category label text, from the categories table (title_color). Fallback '#FB8D67' (the design's own category line).

category_text_color.description: Color of the card title + description text, from the categories table (text_color). Fallback '#FFFFFF' (the design's own white).

version.description: Current version number displayed in the footer version pill.

filter-pill.x-deprecated-reason: No element defines this tag - console toolbar filters were never built. Emitting it draws an empty box. Deprecated rather than deleted (catalogs.md: deprecate, never delete).

allOf.description: Category filter pill for the console homepage grid. Toggles visibility of cards by category.

category.description: The category this pill filters for.

active.description: Whether this filter is currently active.

search-bar.x-deprecated-reason: No element defines this tag - console search was never built. Emitting it draws an empty box.

allOf.description: Search input for filtering console cards by text query.

prompt-section.x-deprecated-reason: No element defines this tag. The implemented element is <prompt-section-editor> (catalog: SectionEditor / prompt-section-editor); this name predates it and nothing draws it.

allOf.description: A section within the prompt composer (left column). Each section has a type that determines its role in the prompt architecture. Used in ResponsivePromptBuilderWithDnD for drag-and-drop prompt assembly.

type.description: The architectural role of this section.

order.description: Display order within the section list.

output-panel.x-deprecated-reason: No element defines this tag. The implemented element is <compiled-output-viewer> (catalog: CompiledOutput / compiled-output-viewer).

allOf.description: The output panel in the middle column that displays AI-generated content. Shows compiled prompt output, evaluation results, and streaming content.

model.description: The AI model that generated this output.

tokens.description: Token count for the generated output.

version-trace.x-deprecated-reason: No element defines this tag. Versions live in the seat's own rail tab (chat-navigation-bar 'versions') and VersionManager; nothing draws a version-trace.

allOf.description: Version history trace component. Displays a timeline of prompt versions with comparison capability. Replaces the React TraceTree component.

sessionId.description: The prompt session this trace belongs to.

x-figma-source.description: Design source of truth for the rail's buttons: the chat button node (74x74; frame 'chat-menu-item' 40001010:25749 filled #FCCD3D with an inset 0 4 4 rgba(0,0,0,0.25) shadow and 8x13 padding; icon instance 40001012:26436, 38x38 at (18,8), #1FACC2; label 40001010:25751, #1FACC2 Inter Bold 13/20). Trace is 40001011:26266. Every button in the rail inherits the container constraint recorded in src/components/registry.json under containers['chat-menu-item'] — the node is compared against that constraint rather than copied. The extracted style spec is cached in PostgreSQL figma_specs and served by the spec endpoint.

allOf.description: Lit web component <chat-navigation-bar>. Right-column tab rail — chat, trace, tools, evaluation, variables, metadata — filtered by the user's departmental role, carrying the catalog-health marker on the chat tab. Renders the designed buttons (Figma chat-button 40001010:25768, trace-button 40001011:26266). Replaces React SidebarNavigation + NavigationButton.

activeTab.description: The currently active tab. Matches the element's TabId union — 'approval' was listed here and is not one.

collapsed.description: Whether the navigation panel is collapsed.

allowedTabs.description: Comma-separated tab IDs to show, filtered by the user's departmental role (element property 'allowed-tabs'). Empty shows every tab rather than an empty rail.

healthCount.description: Open catalog findings (element property 'health-count'). Above zero the chat tab's icon pulses; zero is quiet.

healthState.description: Whether healthCount can be trusted (element property 'health-state'). 'unknown' must never render the same as a clean result.

allOf.description: Lit web component <error-banner>. The system's error channel — the tag the runtime model is already instructed to report failures through (backend/grace_gui.py: 'Use <error-banner message="..."/> only'). Rendered LOUD on purpose: it also carries the case where a component is generated WITHOUT its annotation, which means behaviour is being invented downstream on every surface that places it. Alert, don't block — the surface still renders underneath.

message.description: What went wrong, in a sentence a person can act on.

code.description: Short machine-ish label above the message, e.g. UNANNOTATED-IN-USE.

retry.description: Offer a Retry affordance. Off unless the caller can actually retry something.

ConsoleCardGrid.x-internal-instantiation: renders <agent-card-element> from its own template — an internal sub-piece (recorded nesting, 2026-09-18); the card is never emitted as a component by the model, the grid composes it from /cards

allOf.description: Console card grid. Renders one Lit <agent-card-element> per item in the bound cards list (data model /cards). Implemented by a2ui-console-card-grid in src/components/lit/a2ui-primitives.ts, and it is the only renderer of this component — nothing in the React shell draws a second copy, so /cards is the single list of packages in play.

items.description: Data-bound list of agent cards. Object form: {"path": "/cards", "componentId": "agent-card-template"}.

allOf.description: AI decision surface — shown when the agent needs user confirmation before proceeding (e.g. unsaved changes). Contains a Text message and an ActionGroup of choices.
Row of action buttons for a DecisionDialog. Renders one Button per item in the bound actions list (each item: {id, label, variant}).

items.description: Data-bound list of action descriptors. Object form: {"path": "/actions", "componentId": "action-button-template"}.

allOf.description: Left-column prompt section editor (composer). Renders the ordered prompt sections (System Role, User Role, Tool Call, Few Shot, Context, Constraints + customs) from the bound sections list. Backed by PromptWorkspace/ResponsivePromptBuilderWithDnD.

sections.description: Data-bound list of prompt sections. Object form: {"path": "/session/left_column/sections", "componentId": "prompt-section-template"}.

allOf.description: Middle-column compiled output panel. Displays the assembled/executed prompt output (markdown). Backed by MiddleColumnSlot.

content.description: The compiled output content (Markdown supported). Typically bound to /session/middle_column/compiled_output.

allOf.description: Right-column chat panel — the surface command interface. Conversation scoped to the bound conversation id. Backed by InteractiveChatInterface.

conversationId.description: The conversation this chat panel is scoped to. Typically bound to /session/right_column/conversation_id.

allOf.description: The prompt package control bar: Save Template, RUN, undo, and overflow gripper. Dispatches save-click / run-click CustomEvents for shell integration.

versionText.description: Left status text, e.g. 'Saved: API Documentation Writer'.

isSaving.description: Shows compiling spinner on Save Template while Grace compiles.

allOf.description: Adds a new prompt section to the left column. Optional chips enable {{variables}}, {{multimedia}}, and {{url}} insertion.

chips.description: Insertion chips rendered on the button.

allOf.description: Slim bottom readout area for the prompt package surface: active user ID plus transient status messaging (save, error, compile).

userId.description: Active user UUID, displayed truncated, e.g. u:00000000…0001.

message.description: Transient status line, e.g. Saved, Compiling…, Error text.

allOf.description: Rail readout showing running token usage and estimated cost for the current prompt package.

tokens.description: Total tokens consumed this session, e.g. 2022.

workspace-layout.description: Lit 3-column resizable workspace host (A2UI v0.9.1). Hosts prompt-section-editor (left), compiled-output-viewer (middle), chat-panel (right).

prompt-section-editor.description: Lit prompt section editor (left column). Binds to /session/left_column/sections.

compiled-output-viewer.description: Lit compiled output viewer (middle column). Binds to /session/middle_column/compiled_output.

chat-panel.description: Lit chat panel (right column + console). Binds to conversationId and to the Conversations dropdown's list.

conversations.description: The Conversations dropdown's rows — the package's own conversations (conversations.session_id), newest first, bound to /session/right_column/conversations. Each row is {id, title}.

prompt-container.description: Bordered container (Figma 40000746-6) hosting stacked prompt-input-sections with the vertical format rail.
prompt-container.annotation:
Data: formatLabel — the vertical rail's format line; tokensLabel — the vertical tokens/cost readout line.
State: expanded — the container is always drawn; the rail is its right edge.
A11y: no role of its own — a container.

prompt-input-section.description: One prompt input row (Figma 40000746-94): gripper + role-tile + Functions / Tools + status rail + textarea.
prompt-input-section.annotation:
Data: name, type, content, sticky, minHeight.
On click: section-menu-select { role } when a role is chosen from the tile's menu; section-collapse-toggle { collapsed } on the tile's chevron.
On change: section-content-input { value } as the textarea is typed in.
State: collapsed | expanded.
Disabled: the System Role section is sticky — first, no menu, not draggable, not deletable.
A11y: group, labelled by the role tile's text.

gripper-prompt-input.description: Meatballs drag handle (49x37) — the only drag anchor of a prompt-input-section (Figma 40000746-94).

role-dropdown.description: Role-selector dropdown for a prompt-input-section accordion tile (Figma 40000934-22851). Lists User Role / Agent Role / Tool Call / Custom / Remove; dispatches role-select / role-remove.

role-tile.description: Role label tile 357x43 with Arrow_drop_down menu toggle (Figma 40000746-94).
role-tile.annotation:
Data: label, showMenu.
On click: role-menu-toggle { open } from the caret; role-tile-collapse-toggle { collapsed } from the chevron.
State: collapsed | expanded; menu closed | open.
Disabled: no menu when showMenu is false.
A11y: button, labelled by the tile's own text.

status-bar-prompt-input.description: Vertical activity rail (40px) — Database_fill + lightning_alt_fill_light icons grow with prompt activity (Figma 40000954-23865).
status-bar-prompt-input.annotation:
Data: icons — the activity icons drawn in the rail.
State: idle | active — the icons grow with prompt activity.
A11y: decorative; no label.

prompt-textarea.description: Active-data textarea (Figma 40000746-94; annotation: 'this is a textarea - for active data.').
prompt-textarea.annotation:
Data: value, placeholder, minHeight.
On change: value-input { value } on every keystroke.
State: idle | focused.
A11y: textbox, multiline; labelled by the section's name.

model-selector-button.description: Model selector button (Figma 40000909-4322 'Function - Model Selector Button'): white, radius 6, 'button drop' shadow, fixed 171x40, 'Models' label (Inter Bold 16 #8B8B8B).
model-selector-button.annotation:
Data: label — the current model's name, or "Models" when none is chosen.
On click: model-selector-toggle { open }.
State: idle | open.
A11y: button, labelled by its own text.

allOf.description: The left column's bottom bar: undo, Save Template, RUN — and nothing else. Figma "Left-column-ControlBar" #40000761:261, placed as the last child of the left column container #40000954:23865. Implemented by <control-bar> in src/components/lit/control-bar.ts; the shell listens for its undo-click / save-click / run-click.

isSaving.description: True while a save is in flight; the bar shows its compiling state.

isRunning.description: True while a run is in flight.

allOf.description: The middle column's header row — the design's "output-vontrols" (node 40001034:1186): the selector tile (40001034:1187, text run 40001034:1190) and the published <model-selector-button>. Implemented by <output-controls> in src/components/lit/output-controls.ts, which draws it in every view of the middle column. The selector is a PLACEHOLDER by the owner's instruction (2026-09-18) — it renders with its design tag and role and opens no menu, because no menu contents exist in the Figma pull and the entries are the owner's specification rather than a trace. Sheet: AGENTIC_EDITOR/10-TODO.md P6.

outputType.description: What the selector tile reads — the view this column is showing. The design's drawn value is "Agent Flow" (40001034:1190); it is a property because this tile is the reader's choice at the top of the column, and the drawn value is the example, not the only value.

output-controls.description: The same component as OutputControls, under its element tag. Both names are listed on purpose: the renderer resolves them to one element (COMPOSITE_MAP in a2ui-renderer.ts maps OutputControls to <output-controls>), while the allowlist and the catalog audit name the TAG. The binding is described on the OutputControls entry.

allOf.description: The canvas column's foot, built from the ControlBar master (node 40000761:261, instance 40001096:3241) and implemented by <canvas-footer> in src/components/lit/canvas-footer.ts. It carries a slot for the host's own controls and the canvas's tone switch, and it EMITS `theme-change` rather than restyling the drawing itself. It was the standalone playground's own chrome until the application needed the same foot.

theme.description: The tone the drawing is currently in — '' is the mid-tone this design is drawn in, "dark" is the reference's near-black surface. Set by the host AFTER the footer asks for a change; the footer never writes it itself.

canvas-footer.description: The same component as CanvasFooter, under its element tag. Both names are listed on purpose: the renderer resolves them to one element (COMPOSITE_MAP in a2ui-renderer.ts maps CanvasFooter to <canvas-footer>), while the allowlist and the catalog audit name the TAG.

chat-header.description: One block of the chat column output area: the card, and on a bar the grip row under the card. Draws the readout line and the model mark at the card trailing edge.

output-header.description: The readout block — Figma 40001119-6308, drawn above the conversations bar.

output-footer-area.description: The footer block of the chat column output area — Figma 40001123-6689, imported via the Figma Dev Mode MCP server (get_design_context). The output column's closing shell: the Active/Plugins control, the four 32x32 panel marks (forum, chat history, add-new-conversation, user feedback), the credit line in its own button, and the block's own gripper. This is where the plug-in tool bar loads — the drawing's default view shows the first five tools.
